description: This file defines a React component named ViewCostDetailsModal, which renders a full-screen modal overlay displaying cost details, including a summary view and raw JSON data. It manages state for active tabs, user name fetching, and copy-to-clipboard functionality. The component also processes cost data, fetches user info asynchronously, and renders detailed project and agent information.

methods.name: fallbackCopy
methods.description: Copies text to clipboard using a fallback method with a temporary textarea element.

methods.name: loadName
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches user name based on userId if not already provided, handling loading state and errors.
